kinds.d: Instrument that measures voltage, current, resistance and other electrical quantities.
Electrical meter whose jaws close round a conductor to measure current without breaking the circuit.
Hand-held device that senses studs, metal pipes or live cables behind a surface.
Instrument that measures moisture in timber or building materials.
Hand-held non-contact thermometer that reads surface temperature from infrared radiation.
Camera on a flexible probe with a screen, for looking inside walls, pipes and machines.
Instrument that displays electrical signals as waveforms.
Instrument that measures sound pressure level in decibels.
